description.en-US: Two sermons of Fisher printed in 1532, on the Gospel of the day and the fruitful use of the Word.
description.pt-BR: Dois sermões de Fisher impressos em 1532, sobre o Evangelho do dia e o uso proveitoso da Palavra.

sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 8 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. John Fisher died in 1535; the edition is of 1532 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
